gloss: one's appearance in finery on a big day

definitions.gloss: one's appearance in finery on a big day
definitions.explanation: How a person looks dressed up for an important occasion, such as a coming-of-age ceremony, a wedding, or a graduation; by extension, a person seen at a proud moment.

examples.english: I saw my daughter all dressed up for her big day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成人式|せいじんしき}→成人式：05494_seijinshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{晴|は}れ{姿|すがた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: We keep photos of how she looked at her coming-of-age ceremony.
My grandfather says he wants to stay well until he sees his grandchild on their big day.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{晴|は}れ→晴れ：02936_hare⟧ (formal, festive, as in ⟦{晴|は}れ{着|ぎ}→晴れ着：12995_haregi⟧) + ⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧ (figure, appearance). Usually said by family and friends watching with pride, often of a child or grandchild.
